releases.title: Settings and update cleanup
changes: Removed the ON text to the right of the pronunciation toggle switch.
Added a Set to default button for the reading speed.
Removed the up-to-date box with the version number from the version section.
If Selah is up to date after checking for updates, it now shows the message next to the button.

releases.title: Automatic update notes
changes: Checking for updates now refreshes Selah automatically when a newer build is available.
After the refresh, Selah opens a patch notes window with the version number and what changed.
The update manifest can now list multiple releases so users who skip versions can review every missed update.

releases.title: Read aloud and pronunciation polish
changes: Changed original-language definition pronunciation to a toggle switch.
Saved highlights, saved notes, and search read-aloud buttons now switch between play and pause while in use.
